LanguageData.LC_ThreeBirds_ResonanceWarning: Punishing Bird, Judgement Bird, and Big Bird have all breached simultaneously! An ominous stillness descends over the Black Forest...
LanguageData.LC_AllAroundHelper_EscapedText: {0} has snapped open its chassis and entered cleaning rampage mode! Beware its high-speed rotary saw dashes.
LanguageData.LC_AllAroundHelper_SuppressedText: {0} has powered down and reverted to its containment egg.
LanguageData.LC_JudgementBird_EscapedText: {0} has escaped containment! Its crooked brass scale deals percentage Pale damage that bypasses conventional armor.
LanguageData.LC_JudgementBird_SuppressedText: {0} has been silenced and returned to its containment egg.
LanguageData.LC_JudgementBird_ScaleTiltMsg: Judgement Bird's crooked scale tilts — Pale judgement washes over nearby souls!
LanguageData.LC_BigBird_EscapedText: {0} has emerged from containment with its golden lantern ablaze! Snap entranced colonists out of their trance before they reach its jaws.
LanguageData.LC_BigBird_SuppressedText: {0}'s lantern has dimmed as it collapses back into its containment egg.
LanguageData.LC_BigBird_EnchantedMsg: {0} is entranced by Big Bird's glowing lantern and is walking toward it! Use "Snap Out of Trance" to free them.
LanguageData.LC_BigBird_BiteMsg: Big Bird clamped its massive jaws down upon {0}!
LanguageData.LC_BigBird_SnapOutGizmoDesc: Immediately shake this colonist awake from Big Bird's hypnotic lantern enchantment.
LanguageData.LC_LittleRed_EscapedLabel: Little Red Riding Hooded Mercenary Breached!
LanguageData.LC_LittleRed_EscapedText: {0} has broken free in a hostile fury! Expect rapid scattergun blasts and crimson sickle cleaves.
LanguageData.LC_LittleRed_SuppressedLabel: Little Red Riding Hooded Mercenary Suppressed
LanguageData.LC_LittleRed_SuppressedText: {0} has been subdued and reverted to her containment egg.
LanguageData.LC_LittleRed_EscapeCounterDropMsg: Another Abnormality breached — {0} grows restless (Qliphoth Counter: {1}).
LanguageData.LC_LittleRed_HiredMsg: Little Red Riding Hooded Mercenary accepted the contract and is hunting {0}!
LanguageData.LC_LittleRed_HireDesc: Pay {0} individual PE-Boxes to deploy Little Red Riding Hooded Mercenary as an allied hunter targeting any hostile threat on the map.
LanguageData.LC_LittleRed_RecallDesc: Order Little Red Riding Hooded Mercenary to end her hunt and return directly to her containment room.
LanguageData.LC_BackwardClock_UseGizmoDesc: Order a Level III+ employee to wind Backward Clock (0→4), or a Level V employee to sacrifice themselves at 4/4 charge to trigger Time Rewind.
LanguageData.LC_BackwardClock_NeedLv3: Requires Level III+ employee to charge
LanguageData.LC_BackwardClock_NeedLv5: Requires Level V employee to trigger Time Rewind
LanguageData.LC_BackwardClock_FullyChargedMsg: {0} brought Backward Clock to full charge ({1}/{2})! Ready for Level V Time Rewind.
LanguageData.LC_BackwardClock_RewindText: {0} pulled Backward Clock's final lever and vanished from the timeline.\n\nA blinding temporal pulse swept the facility: {1} non-ALEPH breached Abnormalities/Ordeals were instantly suppressed, and all non-ALEPH Qliphoth Counters were restored.
LanguageData.LC_Schadenfreude_EscapedText: {0} has escaped containment! Pan your camera AWAY from it to freeze it motionless inside its iron box—looking at it unleashes its mechanical drill saws!
LanguageData.LC_Schadenfreude_SuppressedText: {0}'s keyhole eye has shut as it collapses back into its containment egg.
LanguageData.LC_Schadenfreude_WorkWarning: An employee is working on Schadenfreude — pan your camera AWAY from its containment cell!
LanguageData.LC_Schadenfreude_WatchedWorkDropMsg: You stared at {0} during work! Its Qliphoth Counter dropped.
LanguageData.LC_Schadenfreude_InspectWatched: Gaze status: WATCHED (DANGER — look away during work!)
